
<!-- KU ADRC DS COHORT & BOLD -->

```{r extract demographic information}
#| echo: false
#| eval: !expr (any(params[grepl("kuadrc", names(params))] == TRUE)) | (any(params[grepl("bold", names(params))] == TRUE))

# fmt: skip
intakevars <- c("subject_fname|firstname", "subject_lname|lastname", "subject_birthdate|scrn_dob", "sex|birthsex")

intake <- db(!!!intakevars, data = data, event_name = redcap_event_name)

parse_date <- function(date, tryFormats = c("Ymd", "mdY", "mdy")) {
  as.Date(lubridate::parse_date_time(date, orders = tryFormats))
}

dob <- na.omit(unique(parse_date(intake$subject_birthdate)))

if (any(params[grepl("kuadrc", names(params))] == TRUE)) {
  data$frmdatea1 <- dplyr::if_else(
    is.na(data$frmdatea1) & !is.na(data$visityr),
    sprintf("%s/%s/%s", data$visitmo, data$visitday, data$visityr),
    data$frmdatea1
  )

  data$frmdatea1 <- parse_date(data$frmdatea1)

  date <- date_expr <- "frmdatea1"
}

if (any(params[grepl("bold", names(params))] == TRUE)) {
  date <- date_expr <- "anthro_date"
}

# fmt: skip
visit <- db(!!date, final_impression, data = data, event_name = redcap_event_name)

visit <- BRIDGE21:::format_date(visit, !!date_expr)

visit$age_at_visit <- floor(
  as.numeric(
    (as.Date(visit$Date, format = "%m/%d/%Y") - dob) / 365.25
  )
)
```

```{r display person information in a table format for kuadrc cohort}
#| echo: false
#| eval: !expr params$kuadrc_demographics
#| results: asis

fq("sections/demographics/latex/demographics.tex", type = "input")

first_name <- unique(intake$subject_fname)

last_name <- unique(intake$subject_lname)

name <- BRIDGE21:::add_string("Name: " + first_name[1] + " " + last_name[1])

lastvisit <- BRIDGE21:::add_string("Last Visit: " + tail(visit$Date, 1))

age <- BRIDGE21:::add_string("Age: " + max(visit$age_at_visit) + " Years")

subjinfo_df <- data.frame(col1 = c(name, lastvisit), col2 = c(age, ""))

BRIDGE21::flex_table(
  subjinfo_df,
  align = "left",
  widths = c(4, 2.75),
  header = FALSE,
  borders = FALSE,
  footers = visit$final_impression[length(visit$final_impression)]
)

fq(type = "newpage")
```


<!-- ABCDS STUDY -->

```{r extract the person information from the abcds study used for other parts of the report}
#| echo: false
#| eval: !expr (any(params[grepl("abcds", names(params))] == TRUE))
date <- date_expr <- "de_eval_date"

visit <- db(data = data, date = date, event_name = event_code)

visit$formatted_date <- BRIDGE21:::format_date(visit, de_eval_date)[["Date"]]
```
